name: propose_storyboard

input.title: NOVA logo reveal
input.style: Elegant line-draw logo reveal (calm, premium, minimal)
input.styleReason: A fintech wants calm trust and clarity, not hype: long decelerating curves, one accent, no overshoot.

concepts.name: Cut the circle
concepts.idea: The circle draws itself, then a single diagonal slash cuts across it as the last stroke, so the mark reads as one decisive gesture.
concepts.why: A clean cut is a clear decision, which is what a money app promises: simple, direct.

concepts.name: Sunrise
concepts.idea: The circle rises from the bottom edge like a sun, and the slash sweeps across as a horizon line.
concepts.why: Optimism and a new start, but it leans more lifestyle than finance.

concepts.name: Coin turn
concepts.idea: The circle spins once like a coin landing, the slash stamps on as it settles.
concepts.why: Playful and money-literal, but risks feeling gimmicky for a trust brand.

input.notes: Palette: navy #0B1C3D background, off-white #F4F1EA for mark and wordmark, one accent mint #3DDC97 on the slash only. Type: geometric sans, weight 600, wide tracking on NOVA, tagline in muted #8FA3C7 at 36 px. Beats: mark draws 0 to 1.3 s, wordmark slides out from behind the mark 1.3 to 2.3 s, tagline fades in 2.3 to 2.8 s, hold of the full lockup 2.8 to 4 s.

beats.name: Mark draws
beats.description: The circle draws on as a thin off-white stroke (0.1 to 1.1 s). The mint diagonal slash cuts across it as the circle closes (0.85 to 1.3 s).
beats.style: Sine In Out for the circle draw, Expo Out for the slash cut.

beats.name: Wordmark slides out
beats.description: NOVA slides out from behind the mark's right edge, clipped by the mark's edge so it reads as emerging, not fading.
beats.style: Quart Out, 1 s, dx -420 px to rest, no overshoot.

beats.name: Tagline
beats.description: Money, made simple fades in 12 px below the wordmark baseline.

beats.name: Hold
beats.description: Full lockup holds still for 1.2 s, the clean final frame.
